summary: Build practical fire safety and evacuation procedures skills with drills, templates, and real-world emergency planning. Enroll with TrainingCred.
lede: Workplace fire safety training covers hazard assessment, prevention controls and coordinated evacuation response. It is for fire wardens, safety officers, facilities managers and operations supervisors who need to identify hazards, plan escape routes and assembly procedures, decide when extinguisher use is appropriate, and coordinate alarms and roll calls. Learners also practice drills and document findings and corrective actions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who must prevent fire incidents, direct safe evacuations, and document emergency readiness in day-to-day operations.
outcomes: Incident Reporting And Corrective Action Tracking
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of workplace safety principles and site emergency procedures. Prior experience in HSE, facilities, security, operations, or supervisory roles is helpful, and no coding or programming is required. A laptop is recommended for completing templates, evacuation maps, and drill documentation during the course.
